text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day after school, as I was walking down the hallway,
I heard Nakayama Festa and Agnes Tachyon talking.
Peering inside the room—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well if it isn't Trainer.
Heh, did you catch the scent too?
...Of this thrill, that is.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...It's a game with a taste-test on the line. Of "Tachyon's Special Energy Drink," that is. The risk is massive... but so is the return.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
A first-edition run of a card game
said to be created by a legendary gambler...
And what's more, it's unopened.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I got it through a little connection.
Now, not that this has anything to do with that card game, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying so, Agnes Tachyon
placed a deck of cards onto the table.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A game ought to be fair.
In a simple card game against you,
the odds are stacked far too much against me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Then let's do this.
We'll each build a house of cards.
Whoever builds the taller one wins.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Well, that's straightforward enough.
...So, what time?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Five minutes.
âNow then, let us begin!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tier 1—Without a trace of hesitation,
Nakayama Festa picks up the cards
and builds the foundational first tier.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She had a sense of stability that made me feel taking the bet had been worth it.
Thinking I could finally relax, I looked over at Agnes Tachyon—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you've already completed the second tier.
Hmph, looks like you're on a roll.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
What's the deal, Tachyon?
This goes way beyond just "feeling in good shape", doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh, it is nothing. Whenever I ask Cafe to participate in an experiment, she often tells me, 'Only if you can stack ten layers.' So, I am somewhat used to it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However, for some reason, it always
collapses at the ninth tier.
I have never once finished the castle.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Fair enough, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa clicks her tongue.
However, at the corners of her mouth...
a joyful smile begins to spread.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And within just three minutes,
Agnes Tachyon's castle had already
reached its fifth tier.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Two minutes remaining. Tension hangs in the air.
A suffocating sensation washes over me,
as if the atmosphere itself is squeezing tight.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Ghh! Only tier 3 after all that...!
Dammit, at this rate...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Talk about breathtaking, this is exactly what it means...!
Still, ain't bad at all... This burning, stinging thrill—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Achoo.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. My nose was tickling a bit...
No need to worry, though.
I turned away when I did it, right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Hah, bring it on.
Now I'm really getting fired up...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(Still, what am I gonna do?
At this rate, I'll never catch up
to Tachyon.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(Then... it's all or nothing.
You've gotta put it all on the line...!
Right, Nakayama Festa!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ! You, that's...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Up until now, Nakayama Festa had been placing
5 footholds per tier. But now,
she's reduced that number down to just 2—!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Just gotta build it high, right...!
...How's that?! That makes... six tiers...!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Cutting down the base to pursue pure height...!
Efficiency over stability... splendid.
Gambling everything on a sliver of possibility!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Next, onto the 7th tier...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, your eyes are bloodshot! Oho,
your heart is pounding furiously too. You seem to be
desperately suppressing your breathing, but hey, let me take your pulse—!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon's excited hand
...magnificently brings down the house of cards.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Phew... hah, that was pretty exhausting.
Man, this sense of relief is unbeatable.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Unfortunate, but a match is a match.
I concede defeat this time.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Glad you're taking it gracefully. Right, Trainer?
...Wait, hey. You're sweating.
Were you more worked up than I was?
choice_data_list: W-Would you like something to drink...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Glad you're taking it gracefully. Right, Trainer?
...Wait, hey. You're sweating.
Were you more worked up than I was?
choice_data_list: W-Would you like something to drink...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I get how you feel.
Even my throat is bone-dry right now...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: This is all I have right now, but if you'd like. Here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I open the plastic bottle naturally handed to me and chug it down in one go with Nakayama Festa. But that was—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hey!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...It was Tachyon's Special Nutritional Drink.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It was exhausting, though.
I feel like lying down right here.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"That won't do. I'm worried about your health.
Come now, lie down.
I shall nurse you back to health with all my heart."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After politely declining and accepting the limited-edition card, I hurried away from the spot alongside Nakayama Festa.
